claim: Housing cycle has turned; price appreciation and permit issuance confirm upcycle
source_prose: Case-Shiller HPI rising >5% YoY for 3+ months AND building permits >= 1,500K for 2+ months together refute a housing downturn thesis; either leg alone is insufficient
